name: Sram
description: A dwarf, chief architect and senior edificer of the Aether Hub, who chews on pliers while he thinks and yields it to the renegades.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
description_citations.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Junctions at the Aether Hub malfunction as Sram is called to investigate by a Consulate escort.
timeline.quote: That was the fourth junction that had "malfunctioned" this evening

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
timeline.quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Explosions at the Hub interrupt the dispute and Kambal flees by airship.
timeline.quote: "Explosion at junction nine!" said an edificer.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Sram orders a full lockdown and then shuts down the pumps, guessing the renegades jammed the shutoffs open.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The renegades storm the Hub by gondola and breach the security doors, killing Kailash and defeating her troops.
timeline.quote: Kailash and her troops went down fighting.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia confronts Sram, who yields the Aether Hub to the renegades.
timeline.quote: "Then I yield," said Sram. "The Aether Hub is yours."

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

relations.note: Kailash commands security forces guarding the building.
relations.quote: Kailash, a fellow dwarf who commanded the security forces that guarded the building.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.
